title: 5 ChatGPT connectors that do the work for you
description:
Five ChatGPT connectors and apps that do the work for you instead of just chatting. See how new ChatGPT features like Adobe Photoshop, Target, DoorDash, Apple Music, and Gmail turn the chatbot into a real assistant. A simple ChatGPT tutorial for beginners and for business, covering the new ChatGPT apps and how to switch them on for real AI productivity.

#Shorts #chatgpt #aitools

Get the setup for all five ChatGPT connectors here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1ZPlyKoFV4Kfo_QgDuISpJKZG4WPjy8pdyfF1GD20HAU/edit?usp=sharing
